text: 阿波罗全球管理公司首席经济学家托尔斯滕·斯洛克表示：“目前通胀已经不限于经济问题，而是关乎美联储的信誉。自2021年以来，通胀一直高于目标水平。对于世界头号央行而言，高通胀持续的时间非常、非常久。”
text_en: Torsten Slok, chief economist at Apollo Global Management, said: 'Inflation is no longer just an economic issue—it's about the Fed's credibility. Inflation has been above target since 2021. For the world's top central bank, that's a very, very long time for inflation to stay elevated.'
